analysis: The code snippet defines a method readStream that reads from an InputStream into a byte array buffer and writes chunks to a ByteArrayOutputStream using the write method. The write method call is os.write(buffer, 0, len). The parameters are: buffer (instance of byte[]), off (0), len (return value of is.read(buffer)). Since buffer is statically allocated within the method and never null, NullPointerException is avoided. The off parameter is always 0 (non-negative), and len is the number of bytes read, which is at most BUFFER_SIZE (the size of buffer). Since len is non-negative and ≤ buffer.length - off, IndexOutOfBoundsException is also avoided.
remark: All declared exceptions of the write method are avoided in this context. NullPointerException is avoided because buffer is a non-null local array. IndexOutOfBoundsException is avoided because off=0 is non-negative, len is read from the stream and is guaranteed to be non-negative and ≤ buffer.length (since read returns at most buffer.length bytes), and len ≤ buffer.length - off holds.
